outcome: Hypercare shows the live stability result, each criterion's outcome, and lets the PM pause Tola's evaluation
acceptance_criteria: A work item with `criteria:null` (mock `4201`) shows the tag "Setup needed", "Hypercare criteria are not set.", the held stability check with its finding, and no Pause or Continue control — verify: open `http://localhost:4990/work/4201` (mock 4991).

`4202` shows "Evaluating", each criterion with its result tag (unknown ones read "Not known", never Met), a Pause button, and one Engineering reading with the other owner "No reading yet" — verify: page text and `hypercare-live.spec.ts`.
`4203` shows "Qualified" with "Verified", every criterion "Met", and "No open issues." — verify: page.

`4204` shows "Not met", the findings text, the unmet criterion tagged "Not met", the unknown one "Not known", and the open High issue tagged "Blocks hypercare" in a list separate from the readings table — verify: page and DOM (two distinct sections).

Each criterion key maps to the specified wording: `confirmation`, `elapsed_hours`, `metric:<k>` with rule words, `issue_clearance`, and an unknown key shows raw text — verify: unit test on `hypercareLabels.ts`.

State derivation follows the stated order, including `qualified:true` with `criteria` set, `qualified:null` with `criteria` set, and `criteria:null` with any `qualified` — verify: unit test on the state function with all four fixtures plus the edge combinations.

No text "Day N of 30", no Tola step cards, no "Log an observation", "Log an issue", "Record release" or "Ask Tola" appear in any state; no empty heading is drawn when a section has nothing — verify: e2e asserts absence at 1440 and 390; grep for those strings in `frontend/src/features/hypercare` returns only tests.

No actual reading value is drawn and no missing value renders as 0: a missing `due_at` shows the "{minimum_hours} hours from the release" wording; a null `finding` shows no finding line — verify: unit tests.

Release and acceptance section shows counts from `stability/events`, "None recorded" for zero release evidence, and "Not recorded" for a null `acceptance_packet`; it draws no button — verify: page on `4202`; unit test.

Open issues come from `GET /projects/{case_id}/issues`; Resolved and Closed rows are not listed; an owner id missing from `owners[]` shows "No owner"; paging follows `next_before` and stops at 100 — verify: unit test with a two-page mock; network panel.

Events read failing (`4207`) or issues read failing (`4208`) shows that section's retry row while the header, criteria and checks still draw; Try again repeats only that read — verify: open both ids; network panel.
`stability` 404 for `4206` and for a live id the account cannot see show exactly "This record is unavailable." with no difference — verify: open both; compare text.
401 shows the signed-out state linking to `/sign-in?next=<path>`; 403 `csrf_failed` is not shown as no-access — verify: mock scenarios plus unit test.

Pause on `4202` sends exactly one `POST /api/v1/work/{id}/background` with `{"expected_revision": <work revision>, "enabled": false}` and an `X-CSRFToken` header, and no `case_revision`; the button is disabled during the request — verify: Playwright request capture; double click makes one request.
Continue on `4205` sends `enabled:true`; after 202 the page re-reads and shows the refreshed state, not the 202 body alone — verify: e2e counts the two GETs after the POST.

Background errors map as specified: 409 (re-read once, no resend), 403 `csrf_failed` (session refresh, "Press again", one POST), 403, 404, 422 with `fields`, 429, 503, network; no automatic resend after any failure — verify: unit tests count fetch calls per scenario.
A work item with `revision:null` leaves the control disabled with "Not available right now." and sends nothing — verify: unit test.
Neither control is drawn when `watching` is false and `available_control` lacks `resume`; Pause is not drawn in Setup needed — verify: unit test on `BackgroundControl`.

The hypercare feature imports no v7 `WorkItem` type and no file under `frontend/src/features/workspace` is changed — verify: `git diff --stat origin/main -- frontend/src/features/workspace frontend/src/features/work-item` is empty; `grep -rn "api/schema'" frontend/src/features/hypercare` returns nothing.

Adapters: a test registers `stability` and `stability/events`, reads a mock panel through F-85's `adapterFor`, gets `Section[]` that the existing `Sections` renderer draws, and gets the `hypercare.background` descriptor with a `null` revision token kept `null` — verify: `hypercareAdapter.test.ts`.

The only `POST` this feature sends is the background call — verify: `grep -rn "liveApi.POST\|\.POST(" frontend/src/features/hypercare` shows one call site; e2e asserts no other POST during each state.

Against live Django (8030, the Postgres fixture in the runbook, account that can see a hypercare item) the page for a real `delivery-hypercare/v1` work id shows the same state, criteria results, findings and issue list as `curl` of `/api/v1/work/{id}/stability` and `/projects/{case_id}/issues` — verify: compare page and JSON.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390 for the four states: one column on the phone, no horizontal scroll, controls 44 px tall, no axe violations, and the parts that remain match the SCR-46 boards (header tag, criteria list with tags, next block) — verify: screenshots against `design/screens.md` SCR-46 artboards; `hypercare-live.spec.ts` axe run.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` pass and `api-live-schema-drift.test.ts` still passes — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: Medium. The work is read-only apart from one internal pause call, but it is cross-layer. It adds a new adapter and moves from one generic read to dedicated endpoints (`stability`, `stability/events`). It touches no money, identity or data migration. Sources are `screens-d-delivery-issues-escalation.md` SCR-46 and backend answers D-1, D-18 and D-19. The release record and evidence writes that gate go-live are the high-risk part. They sit in F-115B, which goes to the design engineer's merge batch. Product acceptance is required because the client sees the changed hypercare states and metric/issue presentation.
